description: A discovered causal feedback loop in the societal system-dynamics model, with its current regime (virtuous 好循環 / vicious 悪循環 / neutral / transitioning). Assembled by junkan_cld_builder + junkan_loop_classifier from polarity-typed flow edges over stock-observation HISTORY. G5 STRUCTURAL: hypothesisOnly const true — junkan asserts correlation / lagged-sign, NEVER proven causation; every edge carries confidence. G4 STRUCTURAL: actuationTaken const false — emitting this finding triggers NO outward action. On kotoba-kqe this maps to :junkan.loop/* + :junkan.flow/* datoms (ADR-2605262130).

loopType.description: Sign of the product of edge polarities: reinforcing (R) or balancing (B)

currentRegime.description: Read off the recent trajectory of the dominant stock: 好循環 / 悪循環 / 中立 / 遷移中

edges.description: Polarity-typed flow edges forming the loop

confidence.description: G5: aggregate confidence as integer percent 0..100; loops below a Council-set floor are not surfaced

evidenceCids.description: IPFS CIDs of the stock-observation history supporting the loop

hypothesisOnly.description: G5 STRUCTURAL: const true — correlation / lagged-sign only, never proven causation

actuationTaken.description: G4 STRUCTURAL: const false — analysis-only; finding triggers no outward action
